Resolves #19339

`RevealOverlay#onMouseDown` refocuses the overlay root only when nothing on the event path takes focus by itself. A mousedown on an `input`, `select`, `textarea`, a contenteditable or an element with a non-negative `tabindex` keeps the browser's own focus; prose, whitespace, plain containers and buttons keep today's focus-hold refocus. The fields the decision reads (`tagName`, `isContentEditable`, `tabIndex`) are the ones `DomEvents#getTargetData` already serializes for the target and every path node. One static predicate, `RevealOverlay.canTakeFocus`, carries the rule; the JSDoc states why the refocus used to steal a clicked field's focus (it landed after the browser's default action).

Evidence: L2 (the served Institution cockpit on the dev server with this file in its installed engine copy; a real click into the Add agent pane's username field) → L2 required (AC-2 names the served read). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: contained — one guard in one method plus a red-first spec arm; no contract or placement change.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockRevealOverlay.spec.mjs` — the new arm sends an `input` target, a `textarea` on the path, a contenteditable and a `tabindex="0"` target (no focus call), then prose, a `button` and a `tabindex="-1"` target (three root refocuses); the existing empty-payload arm is unchanged. Red-first: with the source reverted and the spec kept, 1 failed / 12 passed; on the branch 13/13. |
| AC-2 | outside-CI: served cockpit at Institution `d058a63` with this file copied into its installed engine, fresh origin (`127.0.0.1`) so no stale SharedWorker: after one click into *GitHub username*, `document.activeElement === input`, the field's classes read `… neo-focus` with no `neo-invalid`, the only `focusout` was `DIV → INPUT`, and typing landed `neo-opus-ada`. Before the fix, the same click left the root focused and the field `neo-invalid neo-is-touched` (the `Required` line and the light border the operator saw). The installed copy was restored from its backup afterwards. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the same spec — a `div` target with a `p` on the path still records `[id, false, true, 'pointer']`. |

## Deltas from ticket
- Buttons stay outside the guard on purpose: not every browser focuses a clicked button, and a button never needs typing focus, so the root refocus after a button click stays (harmless, and it keeps the contract in Safari).

## Test Evidence
- Owning unit tree before push: `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/dashboard` → 1259 passed, 2 skipped.
- Red-first receipt for the new arm: `git stash push -- src/dashboard/dock/interaction/RevealOverlay.mjs` → 1 failed (`expect(received).toEqual(expected)`), 12 passed; stash popped, 13/13.
- The served-cockpit read in AC-2 (an installed-copy patch for the read only; restored).

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] The next Institution build that carries this engine: one mouse click into the Add agent pane's *GitHub username* field keeps focus and shows no `Required` line (open-ended verification on the installed Fleet Manager).
